summary: Independently verified both proposed facts against canonical implementations and byte field declarations; reconciled functionality and all three upstream non-retain dispositions. Retain inherited unchanged knowledge; accept legacy ownership and numeric-semantic deferrals without guessing identities.

proposed_facts.reason: Canonical code writes slot + 1 before swapping input 2 and 3 for team; both destination fields are u8. The proposal correctly qualifies signed addition and destination conversion, preserves ordinary mappings, and records the CPU caller's subsequent team = 4 overwrite.

Canonical helpers confirm timer_enabled, inactive-slot skipping, timeout versus non-timeout qualification, the explicit u8 conversion and fallback 1, team/player loser selection, character normalization, and retained/rejected writes. The functionality document agrees with this correction. Deferring precise x28 and x2_5 meanings, downstream damage consumption, and named character-enum interpretation is appropriate.

contradictions.reason: Accept superseding the unrestricted integer-domain description: byte assignments and potentially overflowing signed slot + 1 require the proposed qualifications.

Accept superseding the outdated timer-field description and incomplete qualification account. Zero stocks can yield fallback 1 in the non-timeout final-frame branch; qualification is not simply positive recorded stocks.

Accept rejection of the stale debug-scene implementation link. The complete canonical source and header contain match/CSS setup and access helpers, not the claimed debug callback table or lifecycle routines. Accept deferring replacement ownership and absent legacy parameter identities rather than guessing transfers or merges.

unresolved: Retain the handoff's uncertainties about original inferred-name spellings, x2_5 and x28 semantics, downstream x12 consumption, and numeric character-enum interpretation.
Accept valid-payload/index and nonaliasing assumptions for CSS helpers; complementary selection remains zero-versus-nonzero rather than a general opposite-slot operation.
Legacy debug-scene ownership and absent parameter identities remain deferred without invented aliases or ownership transfers.
Unchanged research knowledge is inherited explicitly; acceptance covers the verified changes and examined contradictions, not a new independent audit of every retained fact and link.
